title: ラーメンとの熱い勝負！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory asked to eat at a ramen shop known for being spicy.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Agh! It's sh-sho… shpicy! My mouf is on fire!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It'sh sho hod! Id feelsh lige dere'sh a shurigen in my droat!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Bud shdill… dish proobs we foughd brabely! I wan more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says she wants more, but first we douse the flames in our mouths with cold water.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What should I do? It's so spicy! But… I can't just leave it… Ughhh.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey! If you don't want it, I'd be happy to eat it for you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking about ordering more anyway! Besides… if someone needs help, I've gotta step up!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text: U-um! Take mine too if you can! I haven't even touched mine yet, so please take it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sure! For the sake of this store… and as the blazing head of the disciplinary committee, I'm here to help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The cries for help set Bamboo Memory's heart ablaze… It looks like she's got quite a lot of ramen to eat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The cries for help set Bamboo Memory's heart ablaze… It looks like she's got quite a lot of ramen to eat!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer… But you looked like you were struggling so much!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I respect your enthusiasm! If you need help though, don't hesitate to tap me in!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You go, Trainer! When you're ready for more, I've already got some ready!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text: Talk about guts! Just look at those chopsticks fly! I think I'll try again!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You're inspiring everyone, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, people who had already given up decide to finish their ramen, and Bamboo Memory doesn't have to eat any extra.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! Looks like I'm going extra red-hot rounds with this insanely spicy ramen! Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Phew! Sweet… VICTORY!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She slurps down the rest of ramen heroically, and the entire shop roars with applause!
